text:
lia: Starting a config-only rollout for per-tenant throttle floors and a small idle timeout reduction. Canary=5% for 30m during the US off-peak window (02:00–04:00 UTC). Patch id cfg-2026-0421-1. Link: https://go/redwood/changelog/cfg-2026-0421-1 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: ✅ cfg-2026-0421-1 deploy initiated
 - channel: eng-prod-1
 - mode: config-only
 - canary: 5% (30m)
 - initiated_by: lia
 - details: https://go/redwood/deploys/1769993210

sam: ack. quick question — what are our explicit rollback gates for this one?

kevin: propose automatic rollback if either:
 - error_rate delta >= +1.5% absolute over 10m
 - or p95 latency increases by >= 120ms over baseline
 - or request failures tied to kv-cache pressure > 3%

marta: adding context: last time we nudged throttle floors we saw a kv-cache hit drop at ~4% that spiked p95. recommend warming caches and enabling a temporary net-quiesce on big tenants for 15m during canary.

lia: good call. I'll add a short warmup and tenant-quiesce list. snippet below for the canary patch:

```yaml
patch_id: cfg-2026-0421-1
changes:
  - route: /v1/generate
    per_tenant_min_qps: +10%
    idle_timeout_ms: 250  # was 300
    warmup_seconds: 900  # 15m warmup for hot tenants
    quiesce_tenants: [acct-bigcorp, acct-x]
```

opsbot: Observability playbook: https://go/redwood/playbooks/config-canary
Alerts configured:
 - infra.kvcache.drop_rate (threshold 3%)
 - api.p95.latency.delta (threshold 120ms)
 - api.error_rate.delta (threshold 1.5%)
Autobackstop: will post /rollback if any threshold triggers.

deploy-bot: Canary at 5% -> monitoring 10m windows. Will post updates every 5m.

sam: please pin model routing for this route to avoid model-variant fallback during the canary (pin to llama-v2-mlq-2026-03). Small changes in routing + fallback can confound metrics.

lia: pinned route -> llama-v2-mlq-2026-03 for this rollout. noted in the patch.

kevin: if we need to rollback: use `/deploybot rollback cfg-2026-0421-1` and unpin after rollback. Ops will run an immediate traffic-slice to confirm behavior post-rollback.

marta: thanks — I'll watch kv metrics and kick if I see pressure. :eyes:

deploy-bot: 5m update: no threshold breaches. canary steady.

deploy-bot: 20m update: canary passed initial gating (no regressions). scheduling ramp to 100% in 3 steps (35%, 70%, 100%) starting at 02:35 UTC, 10m between steps.

lia: thumbs up. Release notes entry: https://go/redwood/releases/notes#cfg-2026-0421-1 — short summary and rollback instructions included.

sam: on call during ramp. ping me @sam if anything odd. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Reminder: post-deploy smoke check will run at end of ramp and report to #incidents if any alert fires.

deploy-bot: Canary completed 30m with no breaches. Ramp schedule executing. Will confirm when at 100%.

marta: nice, thanks team.

deploy-bot: Ramp reached 100% at 02:55 UTC. Patch cfg-2026-0421-1 fully applied. Archived: https://go/redwood/deploys/1769993210/complete
